get.summary: Read active rules in one authorized Network
get.description: Requires current policy.read. Only consumer-local rule IDs and selectors are returned. At most 1000 rows; incomplete or Resource-based snapshots cannot be edited as Device policy.

200.description: Current policy snapshot; ETag binds policy_revision

post.summary: Terminally revoke a Device and its current key epochs

200.description: The Device is revoked, or the identical committed action is replayed.

post.summary: Atomically publish a compiled packet-policy release

200.description: The compiled policy is active and its Network revision wakeup is durable.

post.summary: Simulate a policy draft against the complete active compiled baseline

200.description: A deterministic, bounded impact preview derived by the publication compiler without authority mutation.

Cache-Control.description: Simulation evidence contains authorization-sensitive graph data and is never cached.

get.summary: List exact-scope Policy approval requests for independent review

200.description: A deterministic UUIDv7-keyset page of retained Policy approval requests.

post.summary: Freshly simulate and retain one exact Policy approval proposal

201.description: The pending request is retained for an independent authorized human.

get.summary: Get one exact-scope Policy approval request

200.description: The retained request and any immutable decision or consumption evidence.

post.summary: Approve one unchanged proposal as a distinct authorized human

200.description: Immutable approval Evidence was committed for one future publication.

post.summary: Explain one exact network.connect decision from active compiled policy

200.description: A bounded allow or default-deny explanation tied to one authority revision vector.

Cache-Control.description: Explanations contain authorization-sensitive evidence and are never cached.

get.summary: List Resources in one exact Network scope

200.description: A deterministic UUIDv7-ordered Resource page.

post.summary: Create a Device-backed Resource

201.description: The Resource is created, or the identical committed creation is replayed.

get.summary: Read one Resource from an exact Network scope

200.description: The current Resource authority snapshot.

post.summary: Preview the exact impact of replacing a Device target

200.description: Deterministic impact evidence for the current Resource version.

post.summary: Replace a Device target using an exact acknowledged impact preview

200.description: The target replacement committed, or its identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Preview an owner transfer or custodian delegation
post.description: Computes deterministic before/after authority evidence. The authenticated Principal must be the current owner. This read-like preview rejects Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Deterministic authority-change impact bound to the current Resource version.

post.summary: Propose a protected Resource authority change
post.description: Requires a fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the current owner and exact acknowledged impact evidence. Creates a ten-minute pending request for the target Principal.

202.description: The pending authority-change request was created, or the identical committed proposal was replayed.

post.summary: Confirm and atomically apply a pending Resource authority change
post.description: Requires a distinct fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the proposed owner or custodian. If-Match identifies the pending request version, not the Resource version.

200.description: The protected Resource authority change committed, or the identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Suspend, resume, or terminally delete one Resource

200.description: The lifecycle transition committed, or its identical result was replayed.

get.summary: List Resource Groups in one exact Network scope

200.description: A deterministic UUIDv7-ordered Resource Group page.

post.summary: Create an immutable Resource Group definition

201.description: The Resource Group is created, or the identical committed creation is replayed.

get.summary: Read one Resource Group from an exact Network scope

200.description: The current Resource Group authority snapshot.

post.summary: Preview an immutable Resource Group definition replacement

200.description: Deterministic membership impact evidence for the current Resource Group version.

post.summary: Append and activate an exact acknowledged Resource Group definition

200.description: The immutable definition replacement committed, or its identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Preview a Resource Group owner transfer or custodian delegation
post.description: Computes deterministic before/after authority evidence. The authenticated Principal must be the current owner. This read-like preview rejects Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Deterministic authority-change impact bound to the current Resource Group version.

post.summary: Propose a protected Resource Group authority change
post.description: Requires a fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the current owner and exact acknowledged impact evidence. Creates a ten-minute pending request for the target Principal.

202.description: The pending authority-change request was created, or the identical committed proposal was replayed.

post.summary: Confirm and atomically apply a pending Resource Group authority change
post.description: Requires a distinct fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the proposed owner or custodian. If-Match identifies the pending request version, not the Resource Group version.

200.description: The protected Resource Group authority change committed, or the identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Suspend, resume, or terminally delete one Resource Group

200.description: The lifecycle transition committed, or its identical result was replayed.

get.summary: List incoming or outgoing Resource Share Offers in one exact Network scope

200.description: A deterministic UUIDv7-ordered page pinned to the local sharing revision.

post.summary: Create a provider-bounded Resource Export and one targeted Share Offer

201.description: The Share Offer was created. The bearer offer token is returned only by this response.

get.summary: Read one Share Offer from an exact provider or consumer Network scope

200.description: The current Share Offer snapshot without bearer token material.

post.summary: Accept, reject, or revoke one still-current Share Offer

200.description: The terminal decision committed; acceptance remains fail-closed in activating state until publication succeeds.

post.summary: Terminally revoke one Trust Contract from either exact Network scope

200.description: The Trust Contract and Imported Resource were revoked atomically.

post.summary: Activate an accepted Trust Contract from its exact consumer Network

200.description: The Trust Contract and Imported Resource were activated atomically after fresh two-sided authority checks.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Device version. Wildcard and weak validators are forbidden.

PolicyIfMatch.name: If-Match
PolicyIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal active Policy revision. Wildcard and weak validators are forbidden.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated opaque key. Core retains only a versioned HMAC digest.

ResourceIfMatch.name: If-Match
ResourceIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource inventory revision.

ResourceGroupIfMatch.name: If-Match
ResourceGroupIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource Group collection revision.

AggregateIfMatch.name: If-Match
AggregateIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource or Resource Group aggregate version.

AuthorityChangeRequestIfMatch.name: If-Match
AuthorityChangeRequestIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal pending authority-change request version. It is not the subject aggregate version.

PolicyApprovalIfMatch.name: If-Match
PolicyApprovalIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Policy approval request version.

PageToken.name: page_token
PageToken.description: Opaque continuation token bound to the collection's pagination state and filters.

DeviceETag.description: The strong quoted decimal terminal Device version.

PolicyETag.description: The strong quoted decimal active Policy revision.

ResourceETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource version.

ResourceCollectionETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource inventory revision.

ResourceGroupETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource Group version.

ResourceGroupLocation.description: The canonical exact-scope Resource Group path.

ResourceGroupCollectionETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource Group collection revision.

AuthorityChangeRequestETag.description: The strong quoted decimal pending authority-change request version.

PolicyApprovalETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Policy approval request version.

PolicyApprovalLocation.description: The canonical exact-scope Policy approval request path.

ShareOfferETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Share Offer version.

TrustContractETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Trust Contract version.

SharingRevisionETag.description: The strong quoted decimal sharing collection revision.

ShareOfferLocation.description: The canonical provider-scope Share Offer path.

CorrelationID.description: A server-generated UUIDv7 used to correlate the safe response and operational log.

RateLimitLimit.description: The burst capacity for the limiter that made the decision.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Tokens immediately available after the decision.

RateLimitReset.description: Whole seconds until one request can be admitted.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds before the caller should retry.

approval_evidence_id.description: Optional for direct publication by an authorized policy publisher. When supplied, immutable approval evidence is freshly validated and consumed; invalid evidence is never ignored.

access_name.description: Required for accept and forbidden for reject or revoke; canonical lower-case consumer-local DNS name.

AcceptShareOfferRequest.description: Acceptance-specific request: imported display name and canonical access name are required. Reject and revoke continue to use DecideShareOfferRequest and forbid both fields.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked, or stale Account Session.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks current exact-scope authority.

InternalFailure.description: Authoritative evidence failed closed because it was internally inconsistent.

NotFound.description: The target is unavailable in the authorized scope.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The resource exists but does not accept this request method.

Conflict.description: Idempotency intent conflict or incompatible terminal state.

Gone.description: The pending protected-change confirmation window expired.

PreconditionFailed.description: The strong mutation version or revision precondition is stale.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The bounded impact set exceeds this API contract.

RateLimited.description: The source or authenticated Account Session exhausted its distributed request budget.

Unavailable.description: Authoritative dependencies, distributed request admission, or bounded process capacity are unavailable.

Timeout.description: The bounded server-side operation deadline expired.
